name: Miranda Moreau
source:
Miranda Moreau is Marguerite's childhood friend and a potential member of Your Character's crew. She is first seen in Chapter 6.

If the player chooses to recruit Miranda, it is revealed that she spent her life around rich people and has learned to fit in with them, making her manipulative at times. Miranda mentions she is afraid of opening up to people for the fear of getting hurt, implying this happened between her and Princess Marguerite. Due to this, she doesn't let people see her true self. If Sybil is also recruited, she notes that Miranda has sadness inside her, not unlike the rich. 

Princess Marguerite is her childhood friend. However, if the player recruits Miranda, it is implied in Chapter 8 that [spoiler]they used to be romantically involved before Princess Marguerite got engaged to Carlisle. It is shown that Miranda still has feelings for her, with Your Character noting Marguerite's reciprocation[/spoiler]. Marguerite asks her to come back to court and stop living so dangerously. [spoiler]They kiss in Chapter 14 if Miranda is part of Your Character's crew.[/spoiler]

[Edited from the [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Miranda_Moreau]Wiki[/url]]
